summary: This completed study looked at how a dietary supplement with plant extracts affects hormones that control appetite in adults who are overweight or obese. A total of 40 participants took either the supplement or a dummy pill for 12 weeks. Researchers measured hormone levels and how full participants felt after eating. The study was sponsored by FFoQSI - Austrian Competence Centre for Feed and Food Quality, Safety & Innovation.
